EDS.GLD_EOD_ACCT_BAL WHERE ACID='PA28762' and EOD_DATE='20230927'

EDS.GLD_EOD_ACCT_BAL WHERE ACID='PA28909' and EOD_DATE='20230719'

EDS.GLD_EOD_ACCT_BAL WHERE ACID='9999' and EOD_DATE='20230920') temp order by ACID, SCD_START_DATE
